title: No title has the wavy line background: Wind Streams is taken out
goal: Some title pages draw a background of thin wavy lines drifting across the frame. The user finds it amateur, like bland wood grain, and wants it gone. Take that background out of every built-in title and out of the backgrounds a title can be restyled to, and give the titles that used it a quiet, refined ground instead.
notes: User, 2026-11-26, with a screenshot of the old Kinetic Bold mid swing transition in their 0.23.0 app: "this screen, the background is so freaking amateur. we need to just remove this. it's like some kind of bland wood grain". Their app was 0.23.0, but the 2026-11-21 redesign kept the same backdrop: Sources/PhotonzCore/TitleSet.swift:344 Condensed Poster `live(.windStreams, ground: "#0F0E0D", ...)` ('ember wind barely in it'). Backdrop: Sources/PhotonzCore/LiveBackdrop.swift (case windStreams, name 'Wind Streams', 'Line Weight' parameter), drawn in Sources/PhotonzRender/LiveBackdrops.swift:482, offered as a restyle at Sources/PhotonzCore/TitleRestyle.swift:246/255/272/765. Keep the enum case decodable for old documents (map it to the plain ground) rather than deleting it outright. Do not redesign the rest of Condensed Poster here; its headline running off the frame is a-main-title-headline-keeps-its-second-line-afte.
acceptance: Reproduced first at Next defaults: Condensed Poster (formerly Kinetic Bold) draws Wind Streams, wavy ember lines on warm black (queue/audits/2026-11-26-sizzle-intake/on-0.25-dev/dev-title-9s.png); the old Kinetic Bold drew the same in white on blue (the user's screenshot, 2026-11-26). List every built-in title and restyle option that draws it.

Wind Streams is no longer drawn by any built-in title page or name card, and is no longer offered as a background when restyling a title. Condensed Poster gets a plain ground in its own palette (warm black, at most a barely visible vignette or soft light falloff), chosen by the redesign task's rules (the title reference board from five-title-pages and seven-more-built-in-titles-look-as-refined), with a before and after picture.

Look at the other live backgrounds (energy streams, sketch, particles, grid horizon, liquid gradient) with the user's words in mind ('amateur', 'bland wood grain', 'clip art'), on a still and in motion, and write down in the audit which, if any, read the same way; take out only Wind Streams here and file the rest as one follow-up with pictures if any clear the follow-up bar.

Documents saved with a Wind Streams background still open: the title shows its replacement ground, nothing breaks, and a test proves it. Tests and walks that pin Wind Streams are updated, not left asserting it.

Audit with every changed title before and after. Anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar (queue/bin/follow-up-bar.md), and written into this task's log if it does not.

log.note: User, 2026-11-26: 'i would love for the sizzle reels to be saved somewhere so i can see samples'. Every reel this task makes (samples, before and after) goes through node queue/bin/reel-add.mjs so it shows on the dashboard's Reels page (http://127.0.0.1:8791/#reels) and in ~/Movies/Photonz Reels; the finished task leaves at least one sample there.
